latest_release.summary: Bitty 0.0.21 released 2026-09-24 from tag v0.0.21 (7da6d6f): plugin services and manifest forms; CLI contract v1 commands; workspace and panel operations; Kitty graphics, input, render, and grid correctness; Rich Scene and semantic-terminal wiring; compatibility and DevTools evidence batches; execution and security-closure evidence; 21-crate workspace. This is a pre-alpha release; no stable, compatible, or security-verified claim is made.

ownership.source_of_truth: This file is the canonical machine-readable source for synchronized revision, snapshot date, maturity, per-risk state, evidence revision/audit references, latest release, subsystem assessments, and sync provenance. Human-readable summaries in README, risk-register, evidence-matrix, TODO, docs/README, release-ladder are derived and validated against it.
